learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to be a great reporter by telling people exactly what someone said, or reporting it in your own words!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Direct speech is when we repeat the exact words someone said! We put their words inside magical little marks called quotation marks. Example: Rahul said, "I am very happy!"
Indirect speech is when we tell someone what was said without using the exact words. We remove the quotation marks and usually change the tense. Example: Rahul said that he was very happy.
When we change Direct speech into Indirect speech, we often use the magic connecting word 'that' to join the speaker and the reported action together!

fun_activity.title: 🎙️ The Family Reporter
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your mom or dad what their favorite food is. First, write their answer in Direct Speech with quotation marks, then rewrite it in Indirect Speech like a news reporter!

quick_recap: ⭐ Direct speech uses quotation marks to show a person's exact words.
⭐ Indirect speech reports what was said without using quotation marks.
⭐ Pronouns and time words often change when we switch to indirect speech!
